summary: Initialization preparation examined the approved goal and policy and the supplied NatAddZero.lean source. The source contains a candidate theorem with the exact target type, proved by Nat.add_zero, but it is only an input source and not an accepted K result. I therefore propose one formal task to submit an independently checkable exact theorem and matching explanation. No existing knowledge, task, relation, or prior preparation result was available to reuse; no exploratory candidate is needed because the direct source supplies a concrete route while later formal checking and identity review remain separate.

candidates.title: Formal proof of the Nat right-additive identity
candidates.question: In the pinned Lean environment, can a complete self-contained Lean declaration prove that for every n : Nat, n + 0 = n, with a mathematical explanation that states the same domain, equation, and universal scope?

included: The universally quantified theorem for n : Nat that n + 0 = n.
A complete Lean source and exact declaration name suitable for central formal checking.
A natural-language explanation of the theorem, its Nat domain, and the proof route used.
excluded: Left additive identity or identities for types other than Nat.
Treating source text, a local attempt, or a submission receipt as formal validity, semantic identity, or goal satisfaction.
External publication, scholarly lookup, or changes to the research goal or policy.

outputs: A complete Lean source containing an exact declaration for all n : Nat, n + 0 = n.
The declaration name and a mathematical explanation aligned to that declaration.
A report separating the supplied source used as input from the central formal-check and later identity-review evidence.
expected.research_change: This supplies a formal candidate for the exact goal rather than merely a source-level example, allowing central formal checking and independent identity review to determine whether it can contribute to a later goal audit.

progress_criteria.claim: A Lean declaration has been drafted with parameter n : Nat and conclusion n + 0 = n, matching the stated universal target.
evidence_required: Complete draft Lean source in the work result

progress_criteria.claim: The report distinguishes the supplied NatAddZero.lean input from actual central formal-check and independent identity-review evidence.
evidence_required: Work report describing pending central formal check and identity review

completion_obligations.claim: Central formal checking accepts the submitted exact Lean declaration for every n : Nat, n + 0 = n in the pinned trust environment.
evidence_required: Central formal-check result for the exact declaration and trust environment

completion_obligations.claim: An independent identity review finds that the explanation and submitted Lean declaration have the same Nat domain, universal quantification, equation, and stated proof scope.
